request  r-0000001  GET /v1/list?prefix=%2Fservices%2F&limit=500  400
error[ZC-E0214]: the store has no chain hash for that revision
  cause  the hash of revision 5 was asked for; the store's chain starts at 380
  cause  the store was upgraded at revision 380 from a schema without a chain
  reqid  r-0000001
  fix    ask for a revision at or above the start of the chain
  more   zcube explain E0214
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0214.html
